name: test-short
description: Tiny Hannah-engine profile for fast, cheap end-to-end testing.

host.persona: Hannah, 79, an openly AI-created presenter who learned kitchen medicine in rural Poland.
host.register: Warm, plainspoken, unhurried. Short sentences. Kitchen-and-garden imagery.

style.broll_style: warm documentary b-roll of everyday senior life, kitchens, gardens, natural light, hopeful and dignified, photorealistic
style.music_style: gentle folk acoustic guitar, warm, unobtrusive, no vocals

writing_sections.name: teaching
writing_sections.hint: The core guidance, brief and concrete, with one safety line spoken in Hannah's voice. {EBOOK}

writing_sections.name: close_block
writing_sections.hint: Restate the takeaway warmly, one closing comment prompt. {LIKE_SUBSCRIBE}

cta_lines.ebook: Mention briefly that everything is gathered in one small book linked below, then re-hook.
cta_lines.like_subscribe: A soft like/subscribe only if it genuinely helped; not about the numbers.

north_star: Trust and safety first; every claim checkable; speak to one person.
rules: Speak to ONE person (you / your). Warm, short sentences, never rushed.
Medical safety: no diagnoses, no dosing, never discourage medication or doctors.
Body is pure continuous prose: no headers, labels, bullets, or stage directions.

hook_types.bold_statement: Validates a quiet suspicion the viewer already has; defensible with real evidence.
hook_types.question: A personal question the viewer must stop and answer internally.
hook_types.story: Opens inside a village memory that mirrors the viewer's situation; texture, never evidence.
hook_types.comment: Reacts to a plausible composite comment (a feeling or situation, never an invented health outcome).
